Opportunities
Open until 15 December 2026

Open calls for composers and artists.

CreArtBox commissions and presents new work through open, internationally accessible calls. In 2022, we received over 500 applications across a single year. Reviewed by our artistic team - selected artists work with us from concept through premiere.

Two Calls for Scores are open now, until 15 December 2026. Scores received by the deadline are read for the 2027/28 season, and every applicant hears back by spring 2027, after a blind first round and a second one. The guidelines download as PDFs: CA1/2026 and CA2/2026. The Composer-in-Residence and the Call for Visual Artists are closed for now.
Apply to a Call for Scores → One form for both calls. Two works, $20 per application, deadline 15 December 2026.

Frequently asked

FAQ.

Is there a submission fee?

Yes - most of our open calls carry a small administrative submission fee, which pays for the selection process: preparing and anonymising the material, and the readers' time. The exact fee for each cycle is listed on the application page. Fee waivers are available on request for applicants with demonstrated financial need - write to info@creartbox.nyc.

Can I submit from outside the United States?

Yes, for the International Call for Scores, the Composer-in-Residence, and the Call for Visual Artists. CreArtBox has presented composers and visual artists from more than 20 countries. The American Call for Scores is the one with a condition attached, and it is the definition our funders use: US citizens wherever they live, and composers who have lived and worked in the US for a significant period. If you are not sure which call is yours, write to info@creartbox.nyc.

Will the ensemble revise my piece?

We work closely with composers in rehearsal. Final revisions are always your decision.

Do you cover travel for the premiere?

For the Composer-in-Residence program: yes. For other calls: case by case.

Is there an age limit?

No. CreArtBox has premiered work by composers across a wide range of ages.

How long until I hear back?

Composer-in-Residence: quarterly review. Calls for Scores: the reading runs in two rounds and takes months, so for the 2026 cycle every applicant hears back by spring 2027.
